verdict.rationale: ESD's own pages say employers 'may file your quarterly tax and wage reports online' through EAMS, accessed via SecureAccess Washington. They also offer step-by-step videos for creating an EAMS account and filing no-payroll reports, and say employers can manage many tasks in eServices. The probe hit an authenticated login wall at secure.esd.wa.gov, which is consistent with a live online filing portal rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: published confirmation that tax payments and new-employer registration can be completed online, amended reports are paper/email/fax-only, and no hands-on corroboration behind the login wall.
